method: Read-only Webflow Data API v2. Collection schemas and every staged item page were read. Only schemas, aggregate counts and public-page matches are retained. Draft/archived flags and lastPublished counts overlap; activePublished excludes draft and archived items. PublishedAtLeastOnce is not a live-endpoint count. Public page matching uses unique published field text (18+ characters) or asset URLs; it proves content presence, not Designer bindings. ReferencedBy comes from schema collectionId validations. Designer filters, sorting and limits are not exposed by these endpoints. Live totals were fetched separately from each collection's /items/live pagination.total. Page-use mappings combine public section roles, matching content and schema references, and must not be treated as a Designer binding export.

messages.pattern: Must be alphanumerical and not contain any spaces or special characters

pageUse.basis: Migration mapping from public section roles, matching content and schema references; not a Designer binding export.
